status: The L2.5 layout spec for Habitat on the LVGL face: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states rest, meet and empty, the namer as an overlay, Habitat's focus as data in place of nav.mjs habitatMove, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the Habitat numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Habitat) and its wireframes 06-habitat.svg to 06g-habitat-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. Habitat is one mibi up close: the mibi in the living window at the left with its name on a tag under it, its card at the top right, four modules under the card, the strip of bays along the foot.

notes.name tag: the mibi's name sits on a tag under it inside the living window, as on Home, so it does not float and the chrome carries system information only; the card does not repeat it. 20 px medium; the box holds ten of the widest letter (200 px, NAME_MAX 10), so the tag is at most 224 wide and a name is never clipped
notes.meet box: the resident's box is 304×312, the box the juvenile stood in on the Incubator's hatch (incubator.json regions.juvenile), so the new mibi reads as the same creature across the hand-off's dither
notes.card: the instrument's readout of this one mibi: who it is (species and stage, where it came from, what it remembers), its code, its stamp and its chapters. The species word is the door to the species' guide. A bonded mibi shows the heart at the end of the card's first row; an unbonded one shows nothing there (no dim heart: the bond is never a need)
notes.carried: the Companion carries up to three mibis (state carried, in carried order). Habitat shows them in three places: the top bar's three faces (frame.json regions.companion), the Companion module's three places, and, while the Companion is away, the outline glyph on their tiles. The Companion module's ✓ queues a request (carryAdd or carryHome) for the shown mibi; a request shows as pending, with the stone lamp on its place, until the Companion applies it at the dock, never as done
notes.bond: the bond is earned on the Companion by tending; Habitat never offers or makes it. On Habitat the bond is a state of the mibi only: the heart on its card, and a bonded mibi cannot be returned to the wild
notes.modules: Home's `module` build with its lamp null: one engraved word and its objects. All four show on every mibi; the Portrait module is always there and opens the sitting, its own screen under Habitat (sitting.json, to come). Companion (wide, it holds the three places) and Portrait on the first row, Cross (wide, it opens a screen) and Wild on the second; Wild, the act that lets a mibi go, sits last, at the bottom right
notes.strip: one tile a bay, at most twelve (one vivarium holds at most twelve mibis): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays. Each tile shows the mibi's thumbnail only; focusing a tile shows that mibi in the window with its name on its tag, and the action names it
notes.namer: the namer (namer.json) is an overlay on Habitat, not a screen of its own, over Habitat's right column, its panel at 592, 48, 416, 424; the living window stays left of x 592 and in view, and the strip stays visible under it
notes.painting: a mibi whose painting has not landed shows its placeholder with the waiting lamp; the words are on the bottom line only. A painting that lands while the mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (Habitat opened again, the strip bringing the mibi back, a wake): never a swap in view
notes.amber: nothing on Habitat is amber: no module, tile, count, bond or free place on the Companion is a need. The notice is the frame's (what needs the player anywhere)

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the plates and the strip's tiles are lists by pitch: { first, pitch, grid }. The strip's `forms` are { name: { upTo, first, pitch, grid } }: n tiles take the form with the smallest upTo at least n. Refused at load: a form with no upTo, two forms with one upTo, a grid shorter than its upTo; refused in props: n > 12 (the bay count is 0 to 12)

initial: by the save and the way in: no housed mibi, empty; arriving from the Incubator's hatch (or Home's ✓ Meet), meet; else rest
stateRule: rest: one housed mibi shown, at rest. meet: the same layout on the first look at a new mibi, from the hatch's hand-off until the first press; the meet ribbon stands in the name tag's place, and the first ✓ opens the namer. empty: no housed mibi; the window, the strip of free bays and the frame only; it does not lead toward growing (Home's ✓ leads to what needs the player). A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the arm of Wild is focus.armed, not a state; the namer is an overlay (overlays.namer), not a state

namer.over: the card and the modules; the living window and the strip stay in view
namer.closes: to rest, the ring on the mibi (from the meet) or on the name (from Rename)

stage.note: the frame's stage; the Habitat master, 1024×522, is to be commissioned

glass.note: no words inside, but the name tag and the meet ribbon

resident.asset: the mibi's standard painting at 304×312 if it has landed, else its placeholder (the stylised rig pass); a juvenile at its own proportions inside the same box

lamp.when: while the placeholder is drawn: the painting on its way, or waiting for the cloud

nameTag.w: the name's width + 2 × pad (24), rounded up to `round` (8), at least `min` (80); the widest name (200 px at 20 px) gives `max` (224). Centred on x 296; the region is the slot it sits in
nameTag.clearance: its top at feet + 24, 12 px under the feet ring (380 to 404), as on Home; its bottom 16 px inside the glass
nameTag.flash: the frame's 240 ms flash when a name is saved (namer.json, `named`)

meetRibbon.note: in the name tag's place, the one ribbon look; it goes on the first press (the namer opens over the right column on ✓; any other key keeps the default name) and the tag shows

heart.when: the shown mibi is bonded (m.bonded); otherwise nothing is drawn there
heart.look: a small enamel heart painted in the house light; never a flat emoji heart, no face, no sparkle
heart.note: at (832, 64): the end of the species line's row, 8 px after the line's box and 16 px before the stamp; not a focus target

mark.at: 4 px after the line's last word, on the line's centre

story.text: strings.story: a founder, where it was found, then what it remembers; a bred mibi, "of {A}" and "and {B}" on two lines, then what it remembers; filled from the top

code.text: the mibi's code in three groups with spaces, no dots ("3MB W21 1BB"), live text, shareable

stamp.live: the mibi's stamp, its read chapters filled

states.unread: the unread ground (its dotted edge painted in) and emblem: a bred child's chapter, still a surprise

plates.note: one plate a chapter, in ring order, left-aligned from x 608: the signed ground, then the emblem 24×24 at (8, 8); no word and no pips: the focused plate's chapter is the bottom line's context

places.fill: carriedIds in carried order, then the pending adds in seq order, then free places
places.note: places at (648, 312), (704, 312) and (760, 312); the last ends at x 808, 56 px inside the module's right edge

place.carried: the mibi's painting or placeholder at 48×48, docked or away
place.free: a composed `dash` outline round the place, 1 px `hairline`, dash [2, 2], as the strip's free bay
place.pendingAdd: the mibi to be taken, its painting or placeholder at 48, with the pending lamp
place.pendingHome: the carried mibi to come home, its painting or placeholder at 48, with the pending lamp

lamp.means: waits for the Companion: the request is applied at the dock (pendingCarry), never shown as done before

states.docked: the solid glyph and the places
states.away: the outline glyph and the places
states.pending: a place with the pending lamp

states.none: no sitting held: the frame's outline
states.held: a sitting held: the gilt frame lit
states.painting: its sitting begun, the crate on its way: the gilt frame
states.portrayed: its portrait came: the frame filled

faces.rule: one face a partner (an adult or an elder of its species, not itself), in bay order: up to seven in one row at y 56; eight to eleven in two rows of up to seven, at y 38 and 64

states.adult: an adult or an elder: one face a partner
states.alone: an adult or elder with no partner: no faces

states.armed: after the first ✓: the gate ajar

tile.fill: a panel rect in the tile's box
tile.free: a composed `dash` outline round the tile's box, 1 px `hairline`, dash [2, 2]; nothing in it, not a target
tile.away: each mibi with you (up to three) while the Companion is away: the outline Companion glyph 16×24 in place of its thumbnail, centred where the thumbnail stands; docked, its thumbnail as any housed mibi

tiles.count: one tile a bay (state.bayCount, 0 to 12): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays

states.shown: the mibi in the window: fill `hairline`, one step up
states.away: the outline glyph, one tile for each mibi with you

moment.do: Spend time: the mibi's species moment, from its moving set when it has one; until then the placeholder hops twice, the creature lift 4 px up and back, whole pixels, at 0 and 900 ms. Rewards nothing and shows nothing like a reward. A press after the hold cuts it to its end

swap.do: the ring moved to another tile: the resident cross-dithers to the tile's mibi (lvgl-switch.md §2.7, the dither event); the tag, the card, the modules and the strip's shown tile are cuts on the frame of the key

meet.from: the Incubator's hatch: its 180 ms dither ends on Habitat in state meet (incubator.json handoff)
meet.do: the meet ribbon shows in the tag's place; the new mibi plays its moment once (no hold); the first press removes the ribbon (a cut): ✓ opens the namer, any other key keeps the default name and does what it does

watch.do: the shown mibi in rest or meet, kept on screen for 60 s, once a mibi a day: the bench trickle (+1 Data within its daily cap) and state.watchResident (the first habit of its not yet seen). Shows only a message plate (strings.watchPlate) and the counter's tick; nothing amber

read.do: a bred child's chapter read: the plate turns from unread to read (a cut) and the stamp prints the chapter's cells row by row from the top over 300 ms, as on Create's grow

release.do: the second ✓ on Wild: the resident dithers out to the next housed mibi in bay order (none: the empty state, a cut); its tile becomes a free bay (a cut); the message plate strings.releasePlate

take.do: ✓ on the Companion module queues the request (carryAdd or carryHome): a cut, the place takes the pending lamp; the request cancelled (the opposite op queued) takes it away. When the Companion applies the requests at the dock, the places, the top bar's faces and the strip's marks change on the next fresh draw (cuts)

refused.do: a request the Companion refused because it was full (S.carryLast, why full): on the first draw of Habitat after the refusal, once, the message plate strings.refusedPlate; the place's pending lamp is already gone. Other refusals (already carried, released, unknown) change nothing the player asked for and show nothing

named.do: the namer saved a name: the tag (or the meet ribbon while it shows) takes the frame's flash

focus.room: only in the empty state: the ring on nothing, no ring drawn; ✓ does nothing (no ✓ cap)

entry.habitatKey: resident, the mibi last seen (frame.json navigation.roomKeys.habitat)
entry.hatch: resident, the new mibi, in state meet (incubator.json handoff)
entry.homeMeet: resident, the new mibi, in state meet (Home's ✓ Meet)
entry.homeResident: resident, the mibi looked at (Home's ✓ Look at)
entry.visit: resident, the mibi visited (the Book's ✓ Visit, a jump)
entry.backFromCross: cross: the target that led there
entry.namerClosed: resident after naming from the meet; name after Rename

selectors.tile.shown: the view resolves it to the shown mibi's tile id; never null while a mibi is shown

focus.rings: each target carries its ring form (frame.json focus.ring.forms): the mibi `feet`, every other target `round`
focus.primitives: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 governs: the edge forms (a name, a selector, nearestIn with ahead, an ordered list), the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres; `axis` walks the group's present targets by index and stops at the ends

name.box: the tag as drawn, inside regions.nameTag.rect
name.present: rest (in the meet the ribbon stands there and is not a target)
name.enabled: always: any housed mibi may be renamed, bonded or with you; never a released one

plate.id: plate.<i>, i from 0 in ring order
plate.enabled: an unread chapter of a bred child that is not sealed

door.enabled: the shown mibi in projectCarried: carryHome; not in it and the projection holds fewer than three: carryAdd; else refused (the Companion is full, no ✓ cap)

portrait.enabled: a sitting is held and sitting.portraitBlock is empty

cross.enabled: an adult or an elder with at least one partner (state.crossPartners, elders counted as adults)

tile.id: tile.<mibi id>, housed mibis only; free bays are not targets
tile.focusShows: focusing a tile shows its mibi in the window (events.swap); the resident target is then that mibi

armed.wild: after the first ✓ on a mibi that may go
armed.clear: any key but ✓ clears the arm; the arm never survives a screen change

focus.held: while events.moment, read or release holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent; while the namer is open its own graph has every key

vectors.note: door centre x 728 is nearer plate 3 (772) than Portrait (940)
the column nearest: plate 2 (centre x 724) is nearest the door's centre (728)
four chapters: plate 3 (772) is the nearest to Portrait's centre (940)

vectors.queues: carryAdd or carryHome for the shown mibi; no arm

keys.pad: moves the ring by focus.graph; on a tile it also shows that mibi (events.swap)
keys.confirm: does the bottom line's action exactly; no ✓ cap, nothing happens; Wild arms on the first ✓ and acts on the second; in the meet the first ✓ names the new mibi
keys.back: Home, wherever Habitat was opened from; Home's ring lands on that mibi when it is at home, else on the room (home.json, ← on a child of Home). While the namer is open, ← is the namer's (namer.json)
keys.room: as everywhere (frame.json navigation.roomKeys); the Habitat key on Habitat puts the ring back on the resident

resident.context: strings.residentContext; a bonded juvenile, strings.growsCarried (it grows only with care on the Companion); while the placeholder is drawn, strings.painting (strings.offline while the Caddy is unreachable)

bottomLine.tile: as resident, for the tile's mibi

species.jump: frame.json navigation.jumps: habitat → book, spread guide; ← there reads Library

unread.price: ◆ and its figure (state.mibiReadCost); none when it costs nothing

take.when: at home, not in the projection, fewer than three in it

cancelAdd.when: a pending add: queues the home op that cancels it

cancelHome.when: a pending home: queues the add that cancels it

full.when: not in the projection and three in it

held.opens: the sitting, its own screen under Habitat (parent habitat, ← Habitat; sitting.json, to come)

bottomLine.price: no price is shown when there is none
bottomLine.notice: the frame's notice only (what needs the player anywhere); nothing on Habitat sets one

masters.note: every master Habitat names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build
list: face-{mibi}-24, face-{mibi}-24-away and face-24-empty in the top bar (existing, frame.json)

strings.title: Habitat
strings.name: Name {name}

story.rule: filled from the top, at most three lines: where it came from (one line for a founder, two for a bred mibi), then what it remembers

strings.painting: its painting is on its way
strings.refusedPlate: {name} stayed home: the Companion was full
strings.measured: 16 px Inter, the face's atlas: take 133, leave 138 (249 with ten W), takeNow 142, takeNext 163, leaveNow 134, leaveNext 168, stayHome 87, stayWithYou 108, full 159, growsCarried 189: every context inside the 208 px zone; refusedPlate 311 (421 with ten W), inside the 640 px plate on one line
strings.portraitOnWay: its portrait is on its way

wildBlocks.rule: withYou covers a carried mibi and one with a pending add; a bonded mibi never goes back to the wild

strings.names: every box that sets a name holds ten of the widest letter at its size: 160 px at 16, 200 at 20, 296 at 28 (NAME_MAX 10); a name is never clipped
strings.note: the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer for the action, a label of six words or fewer for the context; no dot-joined parts; "Again: …" is the arm's wording on every screen
